description: Fetch one public web page and return clean Markdown plus title. For LLM context and RAG. Tables: HTML tables become GitHub-flavored Markdown with a | --- | header row. Nested tables are lifted out as labelled sub-tables under ### Parent row → column headings, with (see Parent → column) in the parent cell. If two nested tables would get the same label, later ones get ', table 2', ', table 3' in document order, so headings stay unique and the same on every run. Pipes in cells are escaped as \|. Links inside cells become [text](url); bold, italic and code markers in the link text are kept; the title attribute is dropped; an href that starts with # is not turned into a link. Example: a Basic row with a nested Limits table becomes | Basic | (see Basic → Limits) | plus a ### Basic → Limits sub-table. Costs $0.005 USDC per call via x402. Without payment, the call returns the x402 payment requirements; retry with an X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, or params._meta["x402/payment"].
name: url_to_markdown
title: Johto Data URL to Markdown
